legacy_narrative.context: Day after Lehman bankruptcy. Money markets seized.
legacy_narrative.what_next: AIG bailout next day. TARP voted down 9/29. S&P -45% over next 6 months. 2y yield collapsed -100bp in 2 weeks.
legacy_narrative.duration: Crisis acute for 8-10 weeks. Full resolution into Q1 2009.

legacy_narrative.context: Same week — Reserve Primary Fund broke the buck. Bill auction tail extreme.
legacy_narrative.what_next: Same arc — Lehman aftermath. Indirect bidders collapsed to 29%.
legacy_narrative.duration: Multi-quarter crisis. Federal funds rate to zero by Dec.

legacy_narrative.context: Bill auction with AAH=6.92 — extreme low-end clustering.
legacy_narrative.what_next: Continued through Oct 8. TIPS auction also stressed.
legacy_narrative.duration: Bill stress lasted ~4 months.

legacy_narrative.context: TIPS auction at the height of Q4 2008 crisis. Real yields elevated.
legacy_narrative.what_next: S&P bottom in March 2009. 5y TIPS yields normalized over Q1-Q2 2009.
legacy_narrative.duration: Real yield distortion persisted into 2010.

legacy_narrative.context: Day WHO declared pandemic. Pre-Fed bazooka. Risk-off cascade beginning.
legacy_narrative.what_next: Mar 15 Fed cut to zero + QE. Mar 23 unlimited QE announced. S&P +75% by Sep 2020.
legacy_narrative.duration: Acute panic 3-4 weeks. Full risk-on regime by August.

legacy_narrative.context: Peak COVID panic. AAH=53.83, indirect collapse to 46%. Funding stress acute.
legacy_narrative.what_next: Mar 23 unlimited QE + Main Street Lending. Lowest stock price 3 days later.
legacy_narrative.duration: Acute for 3 weeks, then explosive recovery.

legacy_narrative.context: First post-bazooka auction. BTC=4.74 = MASSIVE demand for safe assets at zero.
legacy_narrative.what_next: Demand for Treasuries continued through April. Equity recovery began.
legacy_narrative.duration: Stampede pattern lasted ~6 weeks.

legacy_narrative.context: Late-cycle complacency. Crypto top imminent (Nov 8). BTC=3.52 (modestly elevated).
legacy_narrative.what_next: Crypto peak Nov 8. S&P peak Jan 2022. -25% drawdown into Oct 2022.
legacy_narrative.duration: Inflation regime + tightening cycle began Jan 2022.

legacy_narrative.context: Normal market. Sticky inflation backdrop. Healthy auction.
legacy_narrative.what_next: Continued normalization. Rate-cut hopes deferred to Sep.
legacy_narrative.duration: Multi-quarter normal regime.

legacy_narrative.context: Historical comparison: 99.31% of bids at the high yield were allotted. AAH is proration, not a yield tail or dealer share.
legacy_narrative.what_next: Continued normalization. Fed cut 50bp in Sep had been absorbed.
legacy_narrative.duration: Normal regime persisted.
